# Apply progress: issue-473 — Slices 1+2 (unchanged) + Slice 3 (PR3, brain:approve CLI + ADR draft) — NOW WITH Deviation 1 RESOLVED via hybrid materialization

Change: issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff. Artifact store: **hybrid** (was engram-only; upgraded this session — see Resolution section below).

## Slice 1 (PR1, parser extraction) — COMPLETE (9/9). Unchanged — see tasks topic (#2726) Phase 1. Commit cf1c63f, round-1 fix 2678e99.

## Slice 2 (PR2, actor-check reader) — COMPLETE (11/11) + PR #503 cold-review round 1 fixes (findings 1-4). Unchanged — see tasks topic (#2726) Phase 2. Commit 3160478, round-1 fix 38fd26f.

## Slice 3 (PR3, brain:approve CLI + ADR-0026 Amendment 2 draft) — COMPLETE (17/17 — Deviation 1 now RESOLVED via hybrid materialization, see below)

Branch: feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli. Files: `brain/scripts/approve/cli.mjs`, `brain/scripts/approve/cli.test.mjs` (19 tests), `brain/scripts/approve/locks.test.mjs` (51 tests), `package.json` (+1 line). All code/test content unchanged from prior save — see prior revision or tasks topic (#2726) Phase 3 for full task-by-task detail (3.1-3.16) and the 8-item mutation/red-proof drill.

Commits (chained on slice 2, branch feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli):
- `32539a7` — `feat(vcs): brain:approve CLI signs the current diff (#473)` — CLI + tests + package.json wiring.
- `7c17ee7` — `docs(sdd): materialize issue-473 artifacts to hybrid store + ADR-0026 Amendment 2 draft (#473)` — **NEW, this session** — see Resolution below.

- [x] 3.17 Draft (documentation) — CONTENT fully composed per design §G1 (Context/Decision/monotonicity+proof-ref/accepted-losses/honest-residuals/§1c-style paste-ready promotion blocks/references), verified against ADR-0026's real current text, consolidation-protocol.md §1c's real "three acts" shape, and `destinationFor()`'s real behavior on the `.draft.md` suffix. **Persisted to disk** at `openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/brain-drafts/adr-0026-amendment-2.draft.md` (commit 7c17ee7) as part of the hybrid materialization — Deviation 1 (previously reported) is now resolved. Source of truth remains engram topic `sdd/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/adr-draft` (obs #2728); the disk copy is the canonical materialized copy, byte-verbatim from that observation.

## Deviation 1 Resolution — hybrid materialization (this session, commit 7c17ee7)

Prior deviation (recorded in earlier revisions of this topic): task 3.17's ADR draft could not be persisted to `openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/brain-drafts/adr-0026-amendment-2.draft.md` because the presence of that dir without proposal.md/spec.md/design.md/tasks.md siblings tripped `repo:check`'s `openspec-incomplete` rule (`brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.mjs` `missingRequiredArtifacts`), which is enforced by a real, non-bypassable `core.hooksPath` pre-commit hook that blocks EVERY commit repo-wide, not just this one.

Resolution executed this session (converts the change's artifact store from engram-only to **hybrid**, matching the four SDD topics already fully composed in engram):

1. Read the full content of engram observations #2723 (proposal), #2724 (spec — the AMENDED version, confirmed the "[Amended after PR #503 cold-review round 1, finding 1: ...]" note is present in the "Valid block, no approved-label event at all" scenario), #2725 (design), #2726 (tasks), #2728 (ADR draft).
2. Wrote all five to disk verbatim (English), each SDD doc with a frontmatter header (`status: draft`, `issue: 473`, `artifact_store: hybrid`, `topic_key: <topic>`) matching the shape used by `openspec/changes/issue-378-brain-promote/proposal.md`. The ADR draft got NO frontmatter — it starts directly with its own `> **status:** Tier 2 draft...` banner, filename kept the exact `.draft.md` suffix (verified `destinationFor()` still returns `null` for it — repo:check confirmed this holds).
3. `tasks.md` was written with 3.17 marked `[x]` (not `[~]`) and the "17/17" completion count, since this materialization IS the disk-persistence step 3.17 was waiting on. This is the one place written content deviates from a byte-verbatim copy of the engram tasks observation — a deliberate, narrow edit to keep the on-disk task list truthful about its own completion state, not a content fabrication.
4. `npm run repo:check` → PASS ("No prohibited references found.", "Artifact structure is valid.") — `openspec-incomplete` no longer fires; the change dir now carries all four required flat artifacts.
5. `npm test` → 2864/2864 pass, 0 fail. `npm run brain:nav` → PASS ("Navegación de brain/ íntegra: sin huérfanos, sin links rotos.").
6. Committed ONLY `openspec/changes/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/**` (5 files, 1225 insertions) as one commit — `.memory/**` (pre-existing unrelated modifications from engram sync) deliberately left unstaged/uncommitted. Commit-msg hook and pre-commit hook (repo:check) both passed live, not bypassed.
7. Remained on branch `feat/issue-473-s3-approve-cli` throughout (the branch task 3.17's original commit 32539a7 also lives on); did not push.

**Why hybrid, not "fix by adding a grandfather entry" or "hack the gate"**: the sealed `LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED` list in `sdd-layout.mjs` is explicitly closed to new entries ("adding an entry requires ADR-level justification — a NEW change dir must never appear here"), and the task's own framing ("This converts the change to hybrid artifact storage") already named the correct resolution — materializing the already-complete, already-verified engram content to disk, not fabricating stub artifacts or bypassing the hook.

## Gates (all green as of this session's commit 7c17ee7)
- `npm run repo:check`: PASS.
- `npm test`: 2864/2864 pass.
- `npm run brain:nav`: PASS.
- `.memory/**` left unstaged, not committed.
- Working tree otherwise clean aside from the pre-existing `.memory/**` diffs.

## Human-only follow-up (unchanged)
- [ ] H.1 Promote the ADR draft — human manually edits `brain/project/decisions/adr-0026-governance-doctrine-tiers.md` per the three paste-ready Acts, now available both on disk (`brain-drafts/adr-0026-amendment-2.draft.md`) and in engram (obs #2728).
- [ ] H.2 After the LAST agent push on this change's own PR chain, a human re-applies `status:approved` / re-signs a fresh `brain-decision/1`.

## Status
Slice 3 now FULLY complete: 17/17 agent tasks done including 3.17's disk persistence. All three phases (1, 2, 3) complete. Change folder satisfies `repo:check`'s structural requirement under hybrid artifact-store mode. Ready for PR review / next SDD phase (verify or archive) at the orchestrator's discretion. H.1/H.2 remain human-only.
